title: wg followup: PR for mimi-protocol#161 (ParticipantListUpdate apply rules)
description: mimi-protocol#161 ready-for-PR. Rohan's rules: removal indices refer to the list at the end of the epoch in which the AppDataUpdate proposal appears (as MLS Remove); out-of-range or duplicate indices invalidate the whole proposal, as does changing the role of a removed user; adding an existing user is an error. He notes this 'probably needs to be discussed generically for lists that have a non-integral update style'. PR: state these rules in §7.5, and say whether several ParticipantListUpdates in one commit all index the epoch's list (that's where mimid's decision .5.70 differs; see the localfix bead). Bead mimid-1wgh.37.48. Post needs Mark's OK.
close_reason: 2026-10-21: opened mimi-protocol PR #168 (MarkAtwood:participant-list-apply-rules, fixes #161) with Rohan's apply rules incl. epoch-start indexing across multiple updates per commit.
